Dec 2024 • Solo
I chose this spot for dinner because it appeared to have the widest selection of live seafood in the area—and it did not disappoint. The atmosphere was lively and bustling, with quick and efficient service. The garlic snails were a standout, the grilled spiny lobster was cooked perfectly, and the morning glory was fresh and flavorful. Sitting outside under colorful lights and watching people pass by added to the charm of the evening. Overall, good food, a vibrant setting, and great value for the price.
